definitions.gloss: glutinous rice, sticky rice, mochi rice
definitions.explanation: A variety of short-grain rice that becomes very sticky when cooked. Used to make mochi and other traditional Japanese dishes.

examples.japanese: もち{米|ごめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蒸|む}す→蒸す：02307_musu⟧。
もち{米|ごめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{赤飯|せきはん}→赤飯：18955_sekihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make sekihan (red rice) with glutinous rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、もち{米|ごめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{餅|もち}つき→餅つき：14676_mochitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the year, we buy glutinous rice and prepare for mochi pounding.

notes:
Also written {糯米|もちごめ}. The rice used for ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧, ⟦{赤飯|せきはん}→赤飯：18955_sekihan⟧, and ⟦おこわ→おこわ：22455_okowa⟧; it is steamed rather than boiled.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- うるち{米|まい} ({粳米|うるちまい}): ordinary non-glutinous rice, the rice eaten at everyday meals

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧: rice cake made by pounding steamed もち{米|ごめ}
- ⟦{赤飯|せきはん}→赤飯：18955_sekihan⟧: もち{米|ごめ} steamed with red beans, for celebrations
- ⟦おこわ→おこわ：22455_okowa⟧: steamed glutinous rice dishes
- ⟦おはぎ→おはぎ：29365_ohagi⟧: sweet balls of もち{米|ごめ} (often mixed with ordinary rice) coated in bean paste

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- もち{米|ごめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蒸|む}す→蒸す：02307_musu⟧: to steam glutinous rice
- もち{米|ごめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{搗|つ}く: to pound (steamed) glutinous rice into mochi
